screen.atrocities.update.title: ☣ ATROCITIES ☣
screen.atrocities.update.server_required:
This server requires Atrocities %1$s. You have %2$s.
Download the server's version to join.
screen.atrocities.update.server_mismatch:
This server runs Atrocities %1$s, you have %2$s.
You can play, but bosses and machines may misbehave until you match the server.
screen.atrocities.update.ready: Atrocities %s downloaded. It will be installed when the game closes.
screen.atrocities.update.dev_env: Automatic install unavailable here: use the GitHub page.
atrocities.configuration.title: Atrocities Config
item.atrocities.extraction_syringe.hint: Use on a weakened creature to draw a gene sample.
item.atrocities.extraction_syringe.hint2: Consumes an empty Sample Vial. The weaker the target, the purer the sample.
item.atrocities.stasis_capsule.hint: Use on a badly wounded creature to seal it alive.
item.atrocities.stasis_capsule.release_h: Use on a block to release it.
tooltip.atrocities.unstable_warning: The genome convulses. It may abort or mutate during incubation.
message.atrocities.syringe.too_healthy: %1$s resists the needle: weaken it below %2$s%% health.
message.atrocities.syringe.no_vial: You need an empty Sample Vial in your inventory.
message.atrocities.capsule.full: The capsule already holds a specimen. Use it on a block to release it.
message.atrocities.capsule.player: The capsule cannot hold a conscious mind.
message.atrocities.capsule.too_healthy: %1$s still fights back: weaken it below %2$s%% health.
message.atrocities.capsule.corrupted: The specimen dissolved: its data was corrupted.
trait.atrocities.chitin_plating.desc: Overlapping plates that shrug off blows.
trait.atrocities.chitin_spines.desc: Barbed growths that punish melee attackers.
trait.atrocities.regenerative_tissue.des: Flesh that knits itself back together.
trait.atrocities.hypertrophy.desc: Swollen muscle mass. Every blow lands heavier.
trait.atrocities.hemotoxin.desc: Wounds keep bleeding long after the hit.
trait.atrocities.anticoagulant.desc: Victims cannot heal while the toxin lingers.
trait.atrocities.toxic_bile.desc: Corrosive bile, spat or bled onto attackers.
trait.atrocities.adrenal_surge.desc: Bursts of terrifying speed when wounded.
trait.atrocities.void_strands.desc: Unstable DNA that slips through space.
trait.atrocities.hive_mind.desc: Calls lesser spawn to its defense.
trait.atrocities.thermal_organs.desc: Internal furnaces that sear on contact.
